subject.title: perf(sessions): reuse parsed transcripts for successor rotation

question: Should file-backed successor rotation become a read-only consumer of SessionManager’s existing parsed-entry cache for this latency improvement?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but repository policy treats session-state ownership and hot-path cache lifecycle as an intentional boundary that automated review cannot approve on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Accept the cache boundary
options.body: Refresh the branch, let required checks finish, and merge while preserving the narrow validated accessor and cold fallback.

options.title: Keep rotation independent
options.body: Close or redesign the PR if successor rotation must remain isolated from SessionManager’s process-local cache lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Accept the cache boundary
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, let required checks finish, and merge while preserving the narrow validated accessor and cold fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work directly owns transcript-cache invalidation and unsafe-serialization hardening, making this the strongest available decision-routing signal.
